name: kibi-vibe
description: Kibi Mistral Vibe plugin - Agent Plugins 1.0 package with the kibi MCP server (automatic WSL/Windows runtime detection), bundled skills, and context hooks

scripts.build: bun run scripts/build-guard.ts && node --check bin/hooks/kibi-guard.mjs && node --check bin/kibi-runtime.mjs && node --check bin/kibi.mjs && node --check bin/launch-kibi-mcp.mjs && node --check bin/hooks/kibi-common.mjs && node --check bin/hooks/kibi-file-context.mjs && node --check bin/hooks/kibi-prompt-context.mjs && node --check bin/hooks/kibi-session-context.mjs && bun run ../../scripts/sync-agent-skills.ts --write --target vibe
scripts.check:hook-bundle: bun run --cwd ../agent-core build && bun run scripts/build-guard.ts && git diff --exit-code -- bin/hooks/kibi-guard.mjs
